101010001.name: AKM Assault Rifle
101010001.desc: An Onotos Production modified AKM assault rifle, currently the most popular and influential weapon in the AK series. Uses 7.62x39mm ammo.

101010002.name: M4A1 Assault Rifle
101010002.desc: An International Firearms M4A1 assault rifle. Compact and lightweight, it boasts impressive range and power, along with a high rate of fire, making it very versatile. Uses 5.56x45mm ammo.

101010003.name: FAL Assault Rifle
101010003.desc: The well-known FA Corp FAL assault rifle. Solid and reliable, it is user-friendly, easy to disassemble, and comes equipped with a unique gas regulator. Uses 7.62x51mm ammo and is highly acclaimed in military and civilian circles.

101010004.name: H416 Assault Rifle
101010004.desc: This prestigious Helka Corp assault rifle features a short-stroke gas piston system and free float handguard. It is easy to use and can be modified with a variety of accessories. Uses 5.56x45mm ammo.

101010005.name: DT MDR Assault Rifle
101010005.desc: A modular, multi-caliber, compact bullpup rifle from Break Point Zero. It features a high-strength aluminum alloy upper receiver, a barrel with 5 grooves and a right-hand twist, and a lower receiver made from injection molded fiberglass reinforced plastic. Uses 5.56x45mm ammo.

101010006.name: AK-102 Assault Rifle
101010006.desc: A compact rifle made by Gorod with a side folding stock. An export variant of the AK series suitable for mid-range combat environments. Uses 5.56x45mm ammo.

101010008.name: AK-74N Assault Rifle
101010008.desc: The AKM Evo assault rifle was developed by Gorod Industrial to accommodate a new type of ammunition. It features a rail on the left side of the receiver for the mounting of optical scopes. Uses 5.45x39mm ammo.

101010009.name: AKS-74U Assault Rifle
101010009.desc: The AKS-74U is a scaled-down version of the AKS-74 assault rifle, developed by Gorod Industrial for troops in armored vehicles and paratroopers. A close-range defensive weapon. Uses 5.45x39mm ammo.

101010010.name: AUG Assault Rifle
101010010.desc: The AUG is an automatic military rifle produced by Helka Corp. The first assault rifle to use a modular, bullpup design. Uses 5.56x45mm ammo.

101010011.name: F2000 Assault Rifle
101010011.desc: An FA bullpup assault rifle with a glossy exterior. Streamlined and compact, it ejects spent cases after every three to four shots. Uses 5.56x45mm ammo.

101010012.name: AR-57 Assault Rifle
101010012.desc: The AR-57 assault rifle from Break Point Zero, based on the AR series. Upper receiver modification enables the use of P90 magazine and 5.7x28mm ammo. Extremely fast rate of fire and high precision.

101010013.name: ACE31 Assault Rifle
101010013.desc: A new ACE31 assault rifle from FA Corp. Based on the AK series, it incorporates multiple improvements to external parts and accessories. Performs reliably. Ergonomic and precise. Uses 7.62x39mm ammo.

101010014.name: AEK Assault Rifle
101010014.desc: An AEK assault rifle manufactured by Gorod. It incorporates a balanced rotating closed bolt system to provide increased stability during auto fire. Uses 7.62x39mm ammo.

101010015.name: AN-94 Assault Rifle
101010015.desc: An outstanding AN-94 assault rifle produced by Gorod. With a unique 2-round burst mode firing at 1,800 rounds per minute, it has the accuracy of a bolt-action rifle. Uses 5.45x39mm ammo.

101010017.name: FAMAS Assault Rifle
101010017.desc: The FAMAS Assault Rifle is one of FA Corp's most well-known products. With a compact bullpup structure, a clip designed for the cheek, and a bolt installed on the stock, it has a locked standby design and three shooting modes: single shot, 3-round burst, and fully automatic. Uses 5.56x45mm ammo.

101010018.name: SCAR-L Assault Rifle
101010018.desc: A new assault rifle developed by FA Corp that's specifically designed for special operations and can handle complex and changeable combat environments. It has a modular design and different module accessories that can be switched up to suit the style of combat. Uses 5.56x45mm ammo.

101010019.name: T951 Assault Rifle
101010019.desc: The T951 assault rifle has a bullpup-style design, offering good stability and high precision. Due to its shorter chassis, it performs well in close and mid-range combat. Uses 5.8x42mm ammo.

101010020.name: T03 Assault Rifle
101010020.desc: The T03 assault rifle was designed with an optimized modern structure to handle a diverse range of battlefields and all manner of military needs. Uses 5.8x42mm ammo.

101010021.name: SG550 Assault Rifle
101010021.desc: An advanced automatic rifle designed by FA Corp, this firearm features a traditional structure that offers high accuracy, but at the cost of mobility. Uses 5.56x45mm ammunition. Its opening shots are more accurate.

101010022.name: G3 Assault Rifle
101010022.desc: A modernized assault rifle manufactured by Helka Corp, it is an automatic rifle featuring a roller-delayed blowback mechanism and utilizes 7.62x51mm ammunition.

101010023.name: AK12 Assault Rifle
101010023.desc: Gorod's next generation assault rifle's design is based on the AK-74. All aspects of it have been modernized and the improvements ensure that it is both easier to use and more reliable, while boasting improved ergonomics.

101010024.name: MCX Assault Rifle
101010024.desc: Helka's personal defense weapon uses 5.56mm caliber ammo and boasts tremendous firepower and amazing control. Its only weakness is its lack of accuracy.

101010027.name: T191 Assault Rifle
101010027.desc: Unlike the previous generation's T951, the T191 has a conventional structure but uses advanced materials and manufacturing processes for improved performance, modularity, and expandability.

101010028.name: T-192 Short Assault Rifle
101010028.desc: A short automatic rifle developed from the T-191. It has a shorter barrel, making it easier for mechanized infantry to carry and more effective in urban and close-quarters combat.

101020001.name: MP5 Micro SMG
101020001.desc: A classic Helka Corp product, the MP5 micro SMG is outstanding in close combat. Used as a regulation weapon in many countries, it enjoys an excellent reputation. Uses 9x19mm ammo.

101020002.name: MPX Micro SMG
101020002.desc: The MPX micro SMG uses a Helka modular design and features a Picatinny rail for the mounting of optical scopes. Uses 9x19mm ammo.

101020003.name: P90 Micro SMG
101020003.desc: The P90 is an advanced micro SMG from FA Corp. It is the first personal defense weapon adapted to fire newly modified ammunition. Uses 5.7x28mm ammo.

101020004.name: Uzi Micro SMG
101020004.desc: The Uzi submachine gun is a highly effective close-range tactical weapon. Lightweight, easy to use, inexpensive, and simple to manufacture, it is often used in urban warfare. Uses 9x19mm ammo.

101020005.name: UMP45 Micro SMG
101020005.desc: Designed by Helka Corp, the UMP45 micro submachine gun features an open bolt blowback mechanism and rate reducer, increasing control at the cost of rate of fire. Uses .45 caliber ammo.

101020006.name: MP 40 Micro SMG
101020006.desc: Designed with mass production in mind, this micro SMG provides high performance in a simple package. Uses 9x19mm ammo.

101020007.name: MAC-10 Micro SMG
101020007.desc: The MAC-10 micro SMG is a well-known compact firearm with reliable action, made using high-strength steel stampings. Can be fitted with a suppressor. Uses .45 caliber ammo.

101020008.name: M3A1 Micro SMG
101020008.desc: A low-cost submachine gun designed to accommodate growing demand, the M3 is also known as the "grease gun" due to its resemblance to a mechanic's tool. Uses .45 caliber ammo.

101020009.name: T79 Micro SMG
101020009.desc: A lightweight and practical submachine gun featuring a simple design, compact size, high precision, and superior firepower at close range. Uses 7.62x25mm ammo.

101020010.name: QC61 Micro SMG
101020010.desc: A new low-cost submachine gun with limited range, suited to close-range tactical environments. Supports a variety of accessories. Uses 7.62x25mm ammo.

101020011.name: MPF45 Micro SMG
101020011.desc: An improved submachine gun designed by Helka. Lightweight and easy to use, this weapon is suited to close-range tactical environments. Uses .45 caliber ammo.

101020012.name: Vector 45 Micro SMG
101020012.desc: The Break Point Zero Vector 45 micro SMG is suited to close-range tactical environments. A controllable and compact weapon system. Uses .45 caliber ammo.

101020013.name: T85 Micro SMG
101020013.desc: Optimized T79 light submachine gun that features blowback self-loading, allows for single and full automatic fire, and can be fitted with a suppressor. Uses 7.62x25mm ammo.

101020014.name: Vector 9 Micro SMG
101020014.desc: The Break Point Zero Vector 9 micro SMG is suited to close-range tactical environments. A controllable and compact weapon system. Uses 9x19mm ammo.

101030001.name: SVDS Marksman Rifle
101030001.desc: The highly regarded Gorod Industrial SVDS marksman rifle features a side folding stock and high rate of fire. Very reliable. Uses 7.62x54mm ammo.

101030002.name: VSS Marksman Rifle
101030002.desc: A quiet, short-range marksman rifle specially designed for snipers by Gorod Industrial. It has very little muzzle flash and is capable of full automatic fire. Uses 9x39mm ammo.

101030003.name: Mk14 Marksman Rifle
101030003.desc: The Break Point Zero Mk14 marksman rifle is a derivative of the M14 carbine. It can be fitted with optical scopes, night vision, and tactical accessories as the wielder needs. Uses 7.62x51mm ammo.

101030004.name: M110 Marksman Rifle
101030004.desc: A new-gen compact semi-automatic marksman rifle manufactured by Break Point Zero. Compatible with all types of accessories, packed with features, and highly versatile. Uses 7.62x51mm ammo.

101030007.name: U191 Marksman Rifle
101030007.desc: A precision rifle based on the T191. It features a free-floating heavy barrel, lengthened line of sight, and improved accuracy. It comes with an adjustable day scope and a Picatinny rail.

101040001.name: Mosin-Nagant Bolt-Action Rifle
101040001.desc: A Mosin-Nagant bolt-action rifle. Easy to manufacture, simple to use, and very reliable. Requires very little maintenance. Uses 7.62x54mm ammo.

101040004.name: SJ16 Bolt-Action Rifle
101040004.desc: An improved high-caliber rifle with a bolt-action mechanism. Provides high accuracy at long ranges. Uses .338 Lapua Magnum ammo.

101040005.name: M24 Bolt-Action Rifle
101040005.desc: A well-known bolt-action rifle designed and produced by Break Point Zero. It integrates precision and power and boasts outstanding ergonomic properties. Uses 7.62x51mm ammo.

101050001.name: RPK-16 Light Machine Gun
101050001.desc: This modernized Gorod Industrial light machine gun features superior firepower, high precision, and low recoil. Not to be underestimated. Uses 5.45x39mm ammo.

101060001.name: M870 Shotgun
101060001.desc: The Flemington M870 pump-action shotgun provides good reliability and durability in extreme environments. Widely used for hunting and personal defense. Uses 12x70mm shells.

101060002.name: MP-133 Shotgun
101060002.desc: A Gorod smoothbore shotgun with a unique slide stop mechanism. Reliable and durable. Mainly used for hunting. Uses 12x70mm shells.

101060003.name: S12K Shotgun
101060003.desc: The Onotos Production S12K semi-automatic magazine-fed shotgun features high versatility and compatibility with a variety of accessories. Its built-in dust cover provides added reliability. Uses 12x70mm shells.

101060004.name: USAS-12 Shotgun
101060004.desc: The Flemington USAS-12 shotgun employs a gas-operated design with semi-automatic and full-automatic fire options. It lays down sustained and powerful firepower. Uses 12x70mm shells.

101060005.name: SPR310 Shotgun
101060005.desc: The SPR310 is a double-barreled shotgun from Onotos Production with over and under barrel configuration. A very popular shotgun that is commonly used for hunting.

101080001.name: SKS Carbine
101080001.desc: Also known as the SKS 45, this semi-automatic carbine is reliable, durable, and more precise than the AK. It is easy to use and maintain, and the production costs are low. Uses 7.62x39mm ammo.

101080004.name: M14 Carbine
101080004.desc: The M14 carbine features single shot precision, long range, and a sturdy chassis. It is used mainly for hunting, training, and competitions. Uses 7.62x51mm ammo.

101080005.name: M96 Carbine
101080005.desc: The M96 carbine is pneumatically operated and has many special designs incorporated in the action and barrel, making it a very reliable semi-automatic rifle. It uses 5.56x45mm ammo.

101080006.name: Mini14 Carbine
101080006.desc: The Mini14 carbine from International Firearms is based on the M14 rifle, but with lots of innovations and a new design that reduces the cost, making it a popular weapon among civilians. Uses 5.56x45mm ammo.

101080007.name: SA85M Carbine
101080007.desc: A civilian-type carbine modeled after the AKM, made specifically for export. It can only support semi-automatic fire and uses the 7.62x39mm ammo.

101080008.name: BM59 Carbine
101080008.desc: A carbine developed by the FA Corp in the early years. A detachable magazine can be fed into it, but that is now discontinued. It is still very popular due to its reliable performance. It uses 7.62x51mm ammo.

101080009.name: SVTU Carbine
101080009.desc: The SVTU carbine manufactured by Onotos is a gas-operated carbine with magazine feeding that has remained popular to this day due to its reliability. Uses 7.62x54mm rounds.

101080010.name: M16 Carbine
101080010.desc: The M16 carbine from Flemington is the most commonly manufactured weapon that fires 5.56x45mm rounds. It is capable of both firing semi-automatically and in 3-round bursts.

102010001.name: G17 Pistol
102010001.desc: The Helka Corp G17 pistol employs Browning tilting barrel locking, and features auto switch. 40% of parts are made from engineering plastic. One of the most popular service weapons in the world. Uses 9x19mm ammo.

102010002.name: M9A3 Pistol
102010002.desc: The FA M9A3 pistol, the newest variant in the M9 series of guns, features reliable action and a simple design. Uses 9x19mm ammo.

102010003.name: G18C Pistol
102010003.desc: The G18C pistol, the latest improved model of the G17 by Helka, provides a full automatic firing mode, excellent reliability, and a rapid rate of fire. Uses 9x19mm ammo.

102010004.name: MP9 Micro SMG
102010004.desc: The FA MP9 micro SMG features a compact design and high rate of fire, making it ideal for close combat. Uses 9x19mm ammo.

102010005.name: Desert Eagle Pistol
102010005.desc: FA Corp's world-famous Desert Eagle provides impressive firepower at the cost of substantial recoil. Its complex design and low reliability make it unsuitable for harsh battlefields. Uses .44 caliber ammo.

102010006.name: T54 Pistol
102010006.desc: Based on the TT1930/1933 pistol, this firearm is suitable for self-defense and close-range combat. Uses 7.62x25mm ammo.

102010007.name: T05 Pistol
102010007.desc: The sleek and innovative T05 revolver features a compact design and responsive action. It is safe, reliable, and easy to maintain. Uses 9x19mm ammo.

102010008.name: M1911 Pistol
102010008.desc: The M1911 semi-automatic's high caliber provides it with firepower that outclasses most pistols. It is also reliable, durable, and easy to repair. Uses .45 caliber ammo.

102010009.name: M45A1 Pistol
102010009.desc: The International Firearms M45A1 pistol, a modification of the M1911, is suitable for close-range tactical environments. Uses .45 caliber ammo.

102010010.name: Gold Desert Eagle Pistol
102010010.desc: The gold chassis on this FA Corp limited-edition Desert Eagle pistol makes it an attention-grabbing status symbol. Uses .44 caliber ammo.

102010011.name: CZ 52 Pistol
102010011.desc: The CZ 52 military regulation pistol was the first pistol to use the roller-lock operating system. Known for its stability and reliability. Uses 7.62x25mm ammo.

102010012.name: F57 Pistol
102010012.desc: The F57 pistol from FA Corp. People tend to remember it for its ergonomic design. It also features modular modification and powerful performance. Uses 5.7x28mm ammo.

104010001.name: M67 Frag Grenade
104010001.desc: A grenade containing small, preformed fragments. Its steel shell splits into tiny shards on detonation. While it has a large damage radius, it only provides average armor piercing.

104020001.name: M18 Smoke Grenade
104020001.desc: Creates a large cloud of smoke to conceal combatants or other targets.

104030001.name: Z3 Stun Grenade
104030001.desc: A tactical weapon that uses light and noise to effectively incapacitate targets.

104040001.name: M84 Flashbang
104040001.desc: The blast from this grenade generates an intense light over a large area, temporarily blinding anyone who hasn't guarded themselves against it.

104050001.name: Molotov Cocktail
104050001.desc: A glass bottle filled with flammable liquid. Light and toss to create a pool of burning fuel.

104070001.name: GLI-F4 Tear Gas
104070001.desc: This tear gas canister causes violent coughing when inhaled. Contact with the eyes causes burning and temporarily affects vision.

104080001.name: GHO 2 Offensive Grenade
104080001.desc: An offensive grenade with no shrapnel. It contains a large amount of gunpowder. The concussion wave it produces can reach enemies even behind cover, causing them chronic tinnitus and slowing them down.

104090001.name: Mk 2 Frag Grenade
104090001.desc: The shards on this grenade's shell are great for piercing armor.

104160001.name: Downed Emergency Smoke Grenade
104160001.desc: A quick-use smoke grenade that can be manually activated only when downed. This Downed Emergency Smoke Grenade is only distributed to combat squads operating in high-intensity warzones. Its specially designed fuse allows the wounded to deploy a smokescreen while downed, providing cover for the squad's movements.

191010001.name: PCC-9
191010001.desc: A semi-automatic weapon that attempts to incorporate the characteristics of AR series rifles, it offers exceptional recoil control. It uses universal G-series pistol magazines loaded with 9mm pistol ammo.

191010002.name: ZC 807 Assault Rifle
191010002.desc: FA Corp's CZ807 assault rifle. This weapon's modern modular design makes it a favorite among Ocean Alliance battalions.

191010003.name: AMB-17 Assault Rifle
191010003.desc: The AMB-17 is the advanced, silenced model of Gorod's newest AM-17 assault rifle. Uses 9x39mm caliber ammo. It is frequently issued to Tevila's special forces.

191020001.name: PP19-01 Submachine Gun
191020001.desc: A Gorod submachine gun that serves as the modernized, improved version of the PP19.

191030001.name: ML Lever-Action Rifle
191030001.desc: A classic .44 caliber cowboy weapon. Though its 19th century design is outdated, its extensive modernized upgrades and special loading mechanism has allowed it to maintain its own group of fans until this day.

194180001.name: Improved Multi-Burst Flashbang
194180001.desc: An improved flashbang modeled after the basic flashbang. Its stand-out feature is a high-intensity flash produced by multiple consecutive explosions, which completely blinds targets for a short period of time.

201010002.name: Aluminum Vertical Front Grip
201010002.desc: A machine-made aluminum front grip. It can be mounted on a rail to provide enhanced chassis control while firing.

201010003.name: Alloy Tactical Front Grip
201010003.desc: An ultralight tactical grip made from lightweight alloys.

201010004.name: Lightweight Tactical Front Grip
201010004.desc: A lightweight stubby grip, suitable for weapons used in close combat, such as shotguns and micro SMGs.

201010005.name: Stable Triangular Front Grip
201010005.desc: A dedicated front grip with a triangular structure that provides not only comfort, but also better overall handling.

201010006.name: B25 Tilt Front Grip
201010006.desc: A tilt grip that allows the user to more comfortably control the weapon.

201010007.name: Short Vertical Front Grip
201010007.desc: A simple, ergonomically designed vertical front grip.

201010009.name: Lightweight Tactical Vertical Front Grip
201010009.desc: A lightweight vertical grip. Permits the user to operate the weapon in comfort.

201010011.name: AR Compact Tactical Front Grip
201010011.desc: A Break Point Zero front grip. Light, compact, and easy to install. Can be used with the corresponding rear grip assembly.

201010012.name: Lightweight Tilt Front Grip
201010012.desc: Lightweight tilt front grip. Provides superior performance.

201010015.name: RK-6 Front Grip
201010015.desc: The RK-6 front grip. Provides decent weapon stability.

201010016.name: Comfortable Front Grip
201010016.desc: A comfortable front grip. Provides excellent weapon stability.

201010018.name: KIR Tilt Front Grip
201010018.desc: A new generation tilted front grip that provides increased comfort.

201020001.name: AK Series Standard Rear Grip
201020001.desc: Gorod's standard rear grip for the AK-47 and compatible weapon systems.

201020002.name: AK Series Tactical Rear Grip
201020002.desc: A customized Gorod tactical grade rear grip based on the AK series weapon design. Compatible with some light machine guns.

201020003.name: AR Compatible Rear Grip
201020003.desc: A composite material rear grip suitable for all weapons compatible with the AR-15 grip.

201020004.name: Lightweight AR Rear Grip
201020004.desc: A Break Point Zero non-slip rear grip made from a composite of fiberglass, rubber, and other materials. Compatible with all AR series weapons.

201020005.name: Dedicated FAL Rear Grip
201020005.desc: An FA Corp dedicated FAL standard-issue rear grip.

201020006.name: FAL Comfortable Rear Grip
201020006.desc: An FA Corp FAL ergonomic rear grip. Allows comfortable weapons use.

201020008.name: MPX Standard Polymer Rear Grip
201020008.desc: A Helka polymer MPX rear grip, compatible with Gen 1 and 2 MPX micro SMGs.

201020009.name: M9A3 Standard Polymer Rear Grip
201020009.desc: An FA Corp M9A3 standard-issue polymer rear grip.

201020010.name: Gorod Dedicated SVDS Rear Grip
201020010.desc: A rear grip designed by Gorod Group for the SVDS and its variants.

201020011.name: MDR Standard Rear Grip
201020011.desc: A Break Point Zero MDR standard-issue rear grip.

201020012.name: AK Compatible Rear Grip
201020012.desc: A Gorod AK polymer grip, designed to replace the original Bakelite grip.

201020013.name: Lightweight Skeleton AR Rear Grip
201020013.desc: A lightweight skeleton pistol grip, designed with tactical dynamics in mind. Suitable for all guns compatible with the AR-15 grip.

201020014.name: Lightweight AK Rear Grip
201020014.desc: A lightweight dedicated AK grip from Gorod.

201020015.name: KGB Lightweight AK Rear Grip
201020015.desc: A Gorod grip made for the AK series. Provides excellent grip.

201020016.name: RK-3 Industrial AK Rear Grip
201020016.desc: A Gorod grip made for the AK series. Features integrated sealed battery storage.

201020017.name: SAW Tactical AK Rear Grip
201020017.desc: An ergonomic Gorod grip. Inspired by the grip design of the M249 SAW machine gun.

201020018.name: Industrial AK Rear Grip
201020018.desc: A special Gorod AK series grip. Its matte texture provides excellent grip.

201020019.name: Polymer Lightweight AR Rear Grip
201020019.desc: A polymer rear grip suitable for all weapons compatible with the AR-15 grip.

201020020.name: Universal Tactical AR Rear Grip
201020020.desc: A tough, compact, ergonomic stock with an integrated rear grip, suitable for all guns compatible with the AR-15 grip.

201020021.name: Industrial AR Rear Grip
201020021.desc: A matte non-slip rear grip made by Break Point Zero, suitable for all AR series weapons.

201020022.name: Standard Polymer AR Rear Grip
201020022.desc: A polymer rear grip suitable for all weapons compatible with the AR-15 grip.

201020023.name: Lightweight Tactical AR Rear Grip
201020023.desc: A hollow rear grip suitable for all weapons compatible with the AR-15 grip.

201020024.name: Stable Industrial AR Rear Grip
201020024.desc: A matte non-slip rear grip, suitable for all weapons compatible with the AR-15 grip.

201020025.name: M870 to AR Grip
201020025.desc: A Flemington M870 adapter grip that enables the use of an AR stock.

201020026.name: Dedicated Mk14 Grip
201020026.desc: A Break Point Zero dedicated Mk14 grip.

201020029.name: G Series Rubber Grip Cover
201020029.desc: A Helka rubber grip cover for G series firearms. Provides better grip strength.

201020030.name: Dedicated M45A1 Grip
201020030.desc: An International Firearms dedicated M45A1 grip.

201020044.name: T19X Standard Rear Grip
201020044.desc: Standard rear grip for the T19X series.

201030101.name: Classic Red Dot Reflex Sight
201030101.desc: A compact red dot reflex sight suitable for use on all firearms. Lightweight, strong, and durable.

201030102.name: Classic Holographic Scope
201030102.desc: A premium holographic sight. Well-designed and compatible with a wide range of weapons.

201030103.name: Simple Red Dot Sight
201030103.desc: Cheap and easy-to-use reflex red dot sight with a compact design. While it provides excellent performance, it's not very robust.

201030105.name: EKP-8-18 Reflex Sight
201030105.desc: A sight designed for tactical operations. Never officially released.

201030106.name: Full-vision Triangle Reflex Sight
201030106.desc: A triangular sight that does not obstruct field of view.

201030107.name: Compact Reflex Sight
201030107.desc: A lightweight and durable compact reflex sight.

201030108.name: 553 Holographic Sight
201030108.desc: This remarkably well-designed sight provides excellent field of view.

201030109.name: EKP-8-02 Reflex Sight
201030109.desc: A sight designed for tactical operations. Never officially released.

201030110.name: OKP-7 Reflex Sight
201030110.desc: The design of this classic sight allows it to be mounted in multiple positions.

201030111.name: F2000 1.6x Optical Sight
201030111.desc: An FA Corp F2000 1.6x adaptive optical sight. Provides clear targeting even at low visibility.

201030115.name: Triangle Precision Sight
201030115.desc: This sight can cope with various combat situations, and can be adapted to a variety of weapons.

201030116.name: 2x Tactical Sight
201030116.desc: A 2x sight. Adapts to a variety of weapons and combat environments.

201030117.name: Tactical Red Dot Scope
201030117.desc: A tactical red dot sight produced by Gorod. Strong and sturdy. Provides a clear field of view.

201030119.name: M1 Tactical Red Dot
201030119.desc: A lightweight and easy-to-use red dot scope. It is particularly effective when fighting at a close range.

201030201.name: 4x Scope
201030201.desc: A 4x sight. Can be fitted with a special bracket for the installation of compact, low-magnification sights, as well as a mechanical sight for fast aiming.

201030202.name: 3x Combination Holographic Scope
201030202.desc: A multipurpose combination scope with adjustable magnification.

201030203.name: Mosin Dedicated 3.5x Rifle Scope
201030203.desc: A 3.5x optical sight for Mosin rifles. Requires a dedicated 3.5x sight mount.

201030204.name: 3.5x Scope
201030204.desc: A 3.5x sight. Can be fitted with a special bracket for the installation of compact, low-magnification sights.

201030205.name: 1x/4x Scope
201030205.desc: A sight that can switch between 1x and 4x magnification.

201030206.name: 4x Holographic Triangle Scope
201030206.desc: 4x holographic optical sight. Provides accurate carbine firing at medium range, and top mounted reflex sight for combat at close range.

201030207.name: PSO 4x Sight
201030207.desc: The PSO-4 is a Gorod dedicated SVD series sight. Provides 4x magnification.

201030208.name: PZ3 Thermal Sight
201030208.desc: A high-power scope with a thermal imaging feature.

201030209.name: 3x Scope
201030209.desc: A 3x sight. The bracket can be used to install a low-magnification sight to support close-range combat.

201030213.name: T951 3x Scope
201030213.desc: A 3x scope that is dedicated to the T951. It is designed for precise mid-range combat, but it also performs well at close quarters.

201030301.name: Alpha3 1x/6x Sight
201030301.desc: An Alpha3 sight with 1x and 6x magnification. It offers a good field of view for long-range combat.

301010222.name: AL Assault Armored Rig
301010222.desc: In order to increase market popularity, Break Point Zero created this top-level assault armored rig, customized for special operations units. Using the mass-produced model as a basis, the company added an improved assault module carrying system, with no regard to cost, and mounted a variety of equipment adaptation kits. Kurt has confided to others that Rolf once suffered a crushing failure, ending up as the only mission survivor. Since then, Rolf has become more berserk and added heavy close-combat weapon mounts to his rig. At the same time, as a result of efforts to counter the symptoms of his severe PTSD, Rolf became addicted to pills.

301010223.name: AL Tactical Armored Rig

To ensure sufficient defense capability, the designer has reserved slots on the front and back of the vest, which can be loaded with additional inserts as required. As a tactical model of the AL series, this rig adds more equipment interfacing onto the initial base model, in order to fully meet the user's needs. Through measured use of a variety of equipment, Bernard has done a lot for the squad and loves to use this rig. Afterward, his role gradually changed from sniper to comprehensive supporter.

301010224.name: AL Commander Armored Rig
301010224.desc: The AL armored rigs are top-level armored rigs customized for special operations units by Break Point Zero, in order to increase market popularity. Among them, the AL Commander armored rig is the flagship model. It ranks among the best in the series for load capacity and protection power. Kurt was stationed in Espinos as Colom Overseas Commissioner, responsible for the recruitment and training of secret service personnel. After his squad was formed, Kurt applied for funds from above to equip the squad members with weapons and equipment. This top-level armor was on his list.

301040008.desc: A Helka heavy blast helmet, normally used in settings where there is a high risk of explosions.

301040009.name: F70 Tactical Helmet
301040009.desc: A basic tactical helmet produced by Helka using composite materials. Lighter and more durable than earlier models, with an integrated tactical rail that permits the attachment of additional features.

301040010.name: FA Assault Tactical Helmet
301040010.desc: High-end protection from FA Corp, designed for special ops and assault operations. Clean and highly effective—two hallmarks of the FA brand.

301040011.name: IND50 Heavy Tactical Helmet
301040011.desc: The latest offering in the IND series. Provides effective protection with comprehensive tactical interfaces and state of the art ergonomics. Usually issued to elite units.

301040012.name: IND Tactical Helmet
301040012.desc: A tactical helmet from International Firearms made of advanced composite materials. Its ergonomic design provides comfort and convenience. Includes a universal tactical rail that can be fitted with various functional accessories.

301040013.name: SH18 Military Helmet
301040013.desc: A classic Gorod military helmet made from titanium alloy. Lightweight and sleek, with a highly distinctive appearance. Sometimes referred to as a "watermelon."

301040014.name: AS200 Heavy Tactical Helmet
301040014.desc: A top-of-the-line FA Corp heavy tactical helmet. Its simple design features a larger protective area than earlier variants, along with high-grade bulletproofing.

301040015.name: Security Helmet
301040015.desc: A polymer helmet commonly used by security forces. Lightweight and strong, it provides adequate protection against common militants.

301040016.name: 6B5 Helmet
301040016.desc: Upgraded version of the 6B4 helmet, made with advanced materials which greatly improve its performance.

301040017.name: PAS Standard Helmet
301040017.desc: Simplified PAS military helmet made by Onotos. Mostly used by security forces.

301040018.name: KSS Tactical Helmet
301040018.desc: A latest generation tactical military helmet from Helka. Rugged and cool-looking. Suitable for use in all kinds of environments. The only bad thing about it is its price. If you do happen to have the funds, consider buying in bulk.

301040019.name: Motorcycle Helmet
301040019.desc: A cool motorcycle helmet. Its outer shell provides basic protection, but please don't expect it to stop direct fire from heavy weapons.

301040020.name: Tanker Protective Cap
301040020.desc: A retro helmet used by armored vehicle crews, made from aramid with a specially hardened surface.

301040021.name: Retro Steel Helmet
301040021.desc: An antique military helmet made from bulletproof steel. It may be a bit scruffy, but it is great value for money and has been known to stop bullets from time to time.

301040022.name: SH12 Military Helmet
301040022.desc: A heavy-duty military helmet made by Gorod. Popular with frontline troops, but quite uncomfortable. Probably not suited for picky operators.

301040023.name: SH40 Military Helmet
301040023.desc: A premium full-protection military helmet from Gorod. Takes your protection to the next level. Can be fitted with a mask to minimize splatter during mop-up operations.

301040024.name: KSS2 Tactical Helmet
301040024.desc: An improved version of the KSS helmet. Its use of composite materials increases durability but reduces versatility. Suitable for heavy combat units.

301040025.name: IND200 Helmet
301040025.desc: An upgraded version of the IND tactical helmet made by International Firearms. Features enhanced durability while maintaining all the advantages of the original model. Popular with professionals.

301040026.name: 03 Heavy Tactical Helmet
301040026.desc: A heavy-duty tactical helmet, produced in limited quantities for the world's most elite soldiers.

301040027.name: RSP Heavy Tactical Helmet
301040027.desc: A heavy-duty military helmet made by Gorod for export markets. Includes additional tactical features, but excludes headset compatibility to ensure protective functions are not compromised. Chunky and reliable.

301040028.name: SH50 Military Helmet
301040028.desc: Gorod's most premium mass-produced military helmet. Provides first class protection and excellent value for money compared to imported models.

301040029.name: SH Matzka 2 Helmet
301040029.desc: A special variant of the SH series. Shoving this bucket on your head may block out the world, but at least it'll block out the damage as well.

301040030.name: 6B4 Helmet (Squad Skin)
301040030.desc: An Onotos 6B4 helmet issued in limited quantities to elite units. Features modern design paired with all-round protection. A set was awarded to Ajax in recognition of his heroics at the Armory. It was one of the main reasons he decided to follow Renoir.

301040031.name: Lightweight Safety Helmet
301040031.desc: A lightweight safety helmet, commonly used by workmen and firefighters. Made of fluorescent plastic with reflective panels, it is bound to bring a bit of color to the battlefield.

301040032.name: SH65 Military Helmet
301040032.desc: The latest version in the Gorod SH series helmets, made from ultra-high strength composite materials. Can be fitted with masks like the SH65 to further enhance protection.

301040033.name: SH60 Military Helmet
301040033.desc: A top-of-the-line Gorod tactical helmet. Advanced composite materials provide the wearer with enhanced protection. Can also be used with the SH60 mask.

301040034.name: RST Special Forces Helmet
301040034.desc: A Gorod RST heavy duty special forces helmet. Can be optionally equipped with the RST mask. Provides all-round protection at the cost of additional weight.

301040035.name: IND70 Tactical Helmet
301040035.desc: An ultra-high spec ballistic helmet designed for frontline combat. Its polyethylene structure provides the optimal balance of weight and performance. Produced in very limited quantities and only made available to vanguard units.

301040036.name: AN95 Heavy Blast Helmet
301040036.desc: An FA Corp heavy-duty special forces helmet, made from titanium alloy and rated as offering class V protection. Compatible with bulletproof glass masks, which serve to further improve its performance.

301040037.name: Kelsey Fire Helmet
301040037.desc: A vintage firefighter's helmet only seen in old movies. Looks cool, but its ability to block bullets is basically non-existent.

301040038.name: 56K Helicopter Helmet
301040038.desc: A 56K helicopter pilot helmet, made by International Firearms. Features additional lateral jaw protection. Popular with pilots for its macho vibe and excellent performance.

301040040.name: Retro Military Helmet
301040040.desc: A combat helmet considered to be a collector's piece in some circles. It was an advanced design in its day, so it might still be able to block some bullets.

301040041.name: IND Tactical Helmet (Snow)
301040041.desc: A tactical helmet produced by International Firearms, made of advanced composite materials. Its ergonomic design provides comfort and convenience. Includes a universal tactical rail that can be fitted with various functional accessories. Fred often sits lost in thought alone on the Northridge Hotel balcony, looking out across the Timor Sea, watching the sunset over snowcapped mountains. Tales of the Woodland Wraith once struck terror into the hearts of his enemies. When the sun sets behind the snowy mountains, he thinks of his past.

301050001.name: DK6 Security Ballistic Mask
301050001.desc: A universal bulletproof mask made by 926 Equipment, compatible with most security and military helmets that employ universal tactical adapters. Provides enhanced protection without additional encumbrance or affecting the wearer's vision.

301050002.name: DK5 Universal Bulletproof Mask
301050002.desc: A universal bulletproof mask made by 926 Equipment, compatible with most security and military helmets that employ universal tactical adapters. Affordable and provides basic protection, greatly increasing survivability of Dark Zone operators.

301050005.name: DK7 Premium Bulletproof Mask
301050005.desc: A premium bulletproof mask made by 926 Equipment, designed for close combat operations. Blocks low caliber military rifle rounds. Typically used on heavy duty combat helmets. Not very versatile.

301050006.name: 6BNT Blast Mask
301050006.desc: Onotos dedicated 6BNT face armor. Perfectly captures the aesthetic of an old school industrial-style welding mask. Provides unrivalled facial protection.

301050007.name: SH Matzka Mask
301050007.desc: Gorod's upgraded version of the Matzka mask. Offers enhanced protection, although it obstructs the wearer's field of view to a certain extent. Preventing damage is its main priority.

301050008.name: SH60 Mask
301050008.desc: A Gorod bulletproof mask made for the SH60 military helmet. Strong and durable. Provides excellent protection.

301050009.name: SH65 Military Mask A
301050009.desc: A mask used on the SH65 military helmet. Thickened bulletproof glass provides the user with first-class protection and peace of mind.

301050010.name: SH Universal Bulletproof Mask
301050010.desc: A Gorod SH universal ballistic mask, for use with most normal SH series helmet models.

301050011.name: SH65 Military Mask B
301050011.desc: A mask designed to be used with the SH65 military helmet. Uses composite materials instead of glass for better protection at the cost of reduced field of view.

301050012.name: AN95 Military
301050012.desc: A ballistic mask designed for the AN95 helmet. Made from high-grade bullet-proof glass, it provides effective protection against frontal and lateral fire.

301050013.name: RST Special Forces Mask
301050013.desc: A mask that can be fitted on the RST heavy blast helmet. Made from a combination of fiberglass and aluminum to ensure protective capability.

301050014.name: DK8 Military Bulletproof Mask
301050014.desc: A military-grade bulletproof mask produced by 926 Equipment by taking existing bulletproof mask designs and adding thickened frontal protection. It offers excellent defense and is sturdy and durable, but due to its special connection structure, it can only be used on some helmets.

301060001.name: 220 Body Armor
301060001.desc: A mass-produced standard bulletproof vest. It is close-fitting and incorporates bulletproof materials on front and back. However, it does not protect the wearer from large caliber weapons or shots fired at close-range.

301060003.name: SEK Fortress Body Armor
301060003.desc: A tactical military bulletproof vest made by FA Corp. Features a standardized design, with modular armor inserts and easily adjustable size, making it quick and simple to use.

301060004.name: H-LC Tactical Body Armor
301060004.desc: A heavy duty tactical bulletproof vest made by Helka. Features new composite materials, alloy inserts, laser-cut straps, and panels. Comfortable and lightweight.

301060006.name: Marshal Heavy Body Armor
301060006.desc: An FA Corp US Marshal series heavy body armor. Shares the same design as other FA products. Simple and sturdy, it provides effective protection to a large area of the body.

301060007.name: H-Tac SWAT Body Armor
301060007.desc: A lightweight body armor made by Helka. Features a low visibility design, suitable for elite special operations units.

301060008.name: KN Regulation Body Armor
301060008.desc: An early example of mass-produced military body armor from Gorod. While it is made of cheap materials and utilizes an outdated design, it still provides class III protection. It is simple, affordable, and suitable for a variety of uses.

301060009.name: H-LC Lightweight Body Armor
301060009.desc: A lightweight military vest made by Helka which employs an ergonomic design that enables outstanding mobility and flexibility. Usually worn by scouts, assault squads, and other combat units.

301060010.name: BT6 Heavy Body Armor
301060010.desc: A BT series heavy tactical vest, made with the latest fabrics and laser cutting technology. Protects the user from direct fire at close range.

301060011.name: BT101 Tactical Body Armor
301060011.desc: An upgraded version of the BT series heavy tactical vest. Its ceramic pads provide enhanced protection. Available in different materials for different combat scenarios.

301060012.name: Standard SWAT Armor
301060012.desc: A lightweight bulletproof vest favored by professionals in all fields. Close-fitting and unassuming, it can be worn underneath a shirt.

301060013.name: 6B23 Body Armor
301060013.desc: Military body armor made by Onotos Production. While outdated, it provides very effective protection over a large area of the body, including the neck, at the cost of reduced flexibility.

301060014.name: IMTV Samurai Standard Body Armor
301060014.desc: A Helka heavy body armor set, made with new materials which reduce weight while maintaining protective capability. The name speaks for itself.

301060015.name: IMTV Samurai Assault Body Armor
301060015.desc: A Helka heavy body armor set. The Samurai series offensive configuration sacrifices lower body protection for greater flexibility, while also providing enhanced upper arm protection. Suitable for CQB combat.

301060016.name: IMTV Samurai Full Protection Body Armor
301060016.desc: A Helka heavy body armor set, the Samurai series full body defensive configuration maximizes protected areas at the cost of reduced flexibility.

301060017.name: 926 Composite Body Armor
301060017.desc: Military body armor made by 926 Equipment. Features bulletproof composite lining and is certified as providing class V protection. Armor plates are fixed with elastic straps to provide the user with all-round protection.

301060018.name: Spartan B Body Armor
301060018.desc: Spartan series military body armor by 926 Equipment. Extensively tested in the field, this armor is known to be reliable. Its straps and shoulder pads use padded mesh for enhanced comfort and ventilation. This armor is known for its appearance as much as anything else.

301060019.name: Old Security Body Armor
301060019.desc: A bulletproof vest worn by security guards, made from waterproof, windproof fabric that fits well over uniforms. The Kevlar lining serves to protect users during bank robberies and shootouts on the streets.

301060020.name: Defender M4 Heavy Body Armor
301060020.desc: Defender series military body armor by Gorod. An upgraded version of the M4 series, featuring a higher level of protection and larger protective area. Often used by frontline units.

301060021.name: Retro Bulletproof Vest
301060021.desc: Worn out, retro body armor. Still provides a degree of protection against shotguns and small caliber firearms—at least on a psychological level.

301060022.name: Defender M4 Heavy Body Armor (Officer Skin)
301060022.desc: Gorod Defender M4 heavy body armor. Features an enhanced level of protection and a larger protective area. Renoir found a set in a secret underground cache after he seized control of the Armory. He then dispatched Ajax to take the Farm in Arbor.

301060023.name: Security Body Armor
301060023.desc: A regulation bulletproof vest for elite units. Offers additional protection to vital parts without being too bulky.

301060024.name: 6B13 Body Armor
301060024.desc: An improved version of 6B series military body armor made by Onotos Production. Incorporates multiple layers of armor over vital areas. The fabric used is also more durable.

301060025.name: KN Assault Body Armor
301060025.desc: Mass-produced military body armor from KN. Provides more protection than the regulation model, although the additional weight does reduce the user's mobility.

301060026.name: KN Composite Body Armor
301060026.desc: The latest generation of heavy body armor developed by Gorod for export. Incorporates composite fabrics and ceramic armor plates that reduce weight and increase the level of protection. So expensive, only the rich can afford it.

301060027.name: 6B45 Heavy Body Armor
301060027.desc: The heaviest type of mass-produced 6B body armor from Onotos Industrial. Its design takes inspiration from many types of heavy body armor. Made from ballistic steel. A bit on the heavy side, but makes the wearer feel like a tank.

301060028.name: PCA350 Body Armor
301060028.desc: A tactical armored vest from International Firearms, features armor plating on the front and back, a quick release mechanism and easy-to-use rail buckle, making it the perfect choice for getting a head start on your enemy.

301060029.name: IND401 Body Armor
301060029.desc: Tactical body armor from International Firearms, part of the IND tactical series. Provides users with all-round protection.

301060030.name: Retro Sapper Bulletproof Chest Armor
301060030.desc: Vintage bulletproof armor made from forged steel plate. It was originally designed to protect sappers as they swept for mines. Later, it was found to perform well in urban theaters.

301060031.name: Retro Infantry Bulletproof Vest
301060031.desc: An old bulletproof vest used by infantry. The jacket and aluminum bulletproof layer are still intact, but don't expect it to stop any bullets.

301060032.name: BT201 Full Body Armor
301060032.desc: International Firearms BT201 full body armor, designed for extreme battlefield environments. An advanced aluminum alloy covers most of the torso. Only a few were ever made owing to the high cost and weight.

301120001.name: T7 Thermal Imager
301120001.desc: A thermal imager. Can be mounted on a multipurpose tactical rail, providing the user with a wide field of view in the infrared spectrum. Bad news for anyone hiding in the bushes.

301150201.name: RAL Full Gas Mask
301150201.desc: A Break Point Zero mask, made from strong bromobutyl rubber. Features an excellent seal and a wide field of view, ensuring the safety and vision of the wearer.

301150202.name: RAL10 Universal Gas Mask
301150202.desc: A Break Point Zero RAL10 universal gas mask, produced in large quantities to ensure success of operations in challenging environments. Also able to defend against tear gas attacks.

301150203.name: SH-3 Gas Mask
301150203.desc: A universal gas mask made by Gorod, designed with the convenience of left-handed soldiers in mind. Features detachable lateral ports and an adapter that facilitates the installation of different filters.

301150204.name: SH-4 Gas Mask
301150204.desc: A new compact combination full face mask from Gorod Industrial, featuring larger goggles and reinforced seam for a tighter seal and better protection.

301150205.name: RAL40 Premium Gas Mask
301150205.desc: A popular dual-cartridge gas mask by Break Point Zero. It is made from chlorinated butyl rubber components and silicone compounds to prevent infiltration and corrosion. The high degree of flexibility and comfort permits extended usage of the product.

301150206.name: RAL20 Field Gas Mask
301150206.desc: This gas mask is the first choice of all units in the field. It features lenses made from polycarbonate materials that provide protection against UV rays and glare. Manufactured by Break Point Zero and fitted with a new type of filter cartridge.

301150207.name: RAL Goggle Gas Mask
301150207.desc: A next-generation gas mask from Break Point Zero. The main body is made of a proprietary butyl blend material, and the large eyepiece provides soldiers with a wider field of vision.

401010001.name: Fast-acting Painkiller
401010001.desc: A few pain relief pills. Cheap, pocketable, fast-acting, and easy to use.

401010002.name: EX Painkiller
401010002.desc: A bottle of extra-strength aspirin. Reduces pain and inflammation. Can also reduce fever and cold symptoms.

401010003.name: AP Painkiller
401010003.desc: A bottle of painkillers. Provides strong pain relief. For use in emergencies.

401010005.name: Anti-Inflam Painkiller
401010005.desc: A small red pill for reducing inflammation and pain. Cheap and not particularly potent, but suitable for temporary relief.

401010007.name: Liquid Painkiller
401010007.desc: A concentrated painkiller injection. Effective and fast-acting, it will get your injured troops back on their feet in no time.

401010008.name: Energy Drink
401010008.desc: A fast-acting oral stimulant, rich in vitamins.

401030101.name: Quick Bandage
401030101.desc: A common bandage. Good enough for most small cuts, but not large enough to treat major wounds.

401030102.name: Field Bandage
401030102.desc: A combat-ready bandage made by the 926 Company. Keeps wounds clean, allowing them to heal faster.

401030103.name: OPM Bandage
401030103.desc: A polymer bandage made by Chapman. Light, flexible, and durable to help wounds heal faster.

401030201.name: Simple Surgical Pack
401030201.desc: A simple and lightweight surgical pack. Includes only basic surgical tools for patching up injuries to restore a small amount of HP.

401030202.name: Standard Military Surgical Kit
401030202.desc: A standard military surgical kit. Used in temporary wound treatment to help increase the chance of survival on the battlefield. Can restore a small amount of HP.

401030203.name: TMK Military Surgical Kit
401030203.desc: A military surgical kit with a complete set of surgical tools made by Chapman. Designed to treat common battlefield injuries and restore a medium amount of HP.

401030204.name: STO Battlefield Surgical Set
401030204.desc: A field surgery kit made by Elisir Medicina. Not easy to carry. Commonly found at standard Field Hospitals. Capable of completely healing large wounds. Can be used to restore a large amount of HP multiple times.

401030207.name: Battlefield First Aid Kit Set
401030207.desc: Designed by Elisir Medicina for individual combat environments, this Battlefield First Aid Kit Set can be used by soldiers on themselves in an emergency to significantly increase the chance of survival of individual soldiers in deep and dangerous areas. When carrying a first aid kit, you can use it to treat yourself once fallen even if there are no other squad members around.

401030301.name: G-96 Nebulizer
401030301.desc: Medication to treat lung damage from tear gas. Quick and effective.

401040001.name: Standard First Aid Kit
401040001.desc: A convenient first aid kit designed to be carried by troops for quick application on the battlefield.

401040005.name: E3 Military Medkit
401040005.desc: This military medkit from Chapman Equipment has compartments for organization and comes with many emergency-use medicines. This medkit is preferred by squads operating on the front lines.

401040006.name: Simple First Aid Pack
401040006.desc: A light and convenient first aid box full of simple injections. An essential battlefield item.

401040008.name: 926 Rapid First Aid Kit
401040008.desc: This rapid first aid kit from 926 Equipment is specially designed for rescue crews. It's useful in disaster rescue missions.

401040009.name: 100D Battlefield Medkit
401040009.desc: This high-end medkit, specially designed for rescue personnel, is durable, easy to use, and can quickly treat wounds.

401040010.name: STO First Aid Set
401040010.desc: A first aid kit produced by Elisir Medicina specially for medics. This durable and fireproof kit is equipped with various first aid medicines and tools.

401040011.name: TMK Field Medkit
401040011.desc: The field medkit from Chapman Equipment is designed for special operations units. Stealthy and practical.

401050001.name: Regen Booster
401050001.desc: An injection containing enzymes extracted from pit vipers. When used, it activates the body's self-healing capabilities. It's very effective at restoring a large amount of HP over a period of time.

401050003.name: Regen Injection
401050003.desc: An injection containing a hormone that restores a small amount of HP over a short period of time. A cheap and effective first aid solution for the battlefield.

401050004.name: Endurance Booster
401050004.desc: An incredible strength enhancement formula specially developed for high-endurance operations. Reduces energy consumption for a period of time, relieving fatigue and quickly restoring stamina.

401050005.name: Endurance Injection
401050005.desc: An injection used to stimulate the central nervous system. Can quickly activate the body's functions and maintain stamina, but the injection does not last long.

401050006.name: Strength Booster
401050006.desc: An injection developed for field combat troops. It quickly increases muscle mass and carrying capacity for heavy loads.

401050007.name: Str. Injection
401050007.desc: An injection that can enhance muscles and improve carrying capacity. The only downside is its short duration.

404010001.name: Mountain Spring Water
404010001.desc: A bottle of high-quality spring water, rich in minerals.

404010002.name: Apple Juice
404010002.desc: A nutrient-rich apple juice with pulp. Cool, refreshing, and delicious.

404010003.name: Vienna Lemonade Drink
404010003.desc: A common citrus-flavored drink. Quenches thirst and helps you cool down, but doesn't contain much actual juice.

404010004.name: C++ Mango Juice
404010004.desc: A fortified pureed fruit drink containing a variety of nutrients.

404010005.name: C++ Pineapple Juice
404010005.desc: Pure concentrated pineapple juice. Very refreshing.

404010006.name: Taurine Drink
404010006.desc: A functional sports drink with taurine for fast hydration.

404010007.name: Pacific Soda
404010007.desc: A common drink called Pacific. Delicious and affordable. Can relieve fatigue.

404010008.name: Wyllie Original Thermos
404010008.desc: This insulated bottle made by Wyllie Co. has a large capacity and tight seal. Allows you to carry a good amount of hot water.

404010009.name: Canary Orange Juice
404010009.desc: A delicious orange juice. Full of vitamin C, this drink is healthy and hydrating.

404010010.name: Canary Milk
404010010.desc: This Canary brand milk from Wyllie Co., Inc. is rich, tasty, and energizing.

404010011.name: Nom Nom Energy Drink
404010011.desc: This energy drink is a favorite among operators. Rich in various nutrients, it's the perfect choice for regaining your strength on the battlefield.

404020001.name: Braised Ribs Field Ration
404020001.desc: An easy to eat delicacy that can be enjoyed in the wild. Has a long shelf life.

404020002.name: Canned Meat
404020002.desc: Hearty meat in a can. Its flavor and color have been preserved well.

404020003.name: Compressed Hardtack
404020003.desc: These crispy rice crackers make a great hunger-relieving snack.

404020004.name: Canned Carp
404020004.desc: Ready to eat canned carp. Has a long shelf life.

404020005.name: Canned Stew
404020005.desc: Tasty and easy-to-carry canned stew. It has a long shelf life.

404020006.name: Canned Salted Herring
404020006.desc: Pickled herring is known for its stench. The herring expands as it ferments, causing it to spew a large amount of liquid when opening its lid.

404020007.name: Biscuit
404020007.desc: A snack made from grain that quickly replenishes calories.

404020008.name: Canary Condensed Milk
404020008.desc: A popular milk product made by Wyllie Co. Generally used with dry rations. Has a long shelf life.

404020009.name: Ultra-Strength Energy Bar
404020009.desc: An energy bar designed for athletes. It's mainly composed of carbohydrates and protein.

404020010.name: Nom Nom Sugar
404020010.desc: This bagged sugar extracted from sugarcane is a rare commodity in times of supply shortages.

404020011.name: Cuts Classic Chips
404020011.desc: Original flavor chips produced by Dawing Co. Ltd. Classic and delicious, but they'll make you thirsty.

404020012.name: Cuts Cucumber-Flavored Chips
404020012.desc: These fresh, cucumber-flavored potato chips are treasured by chip lovers—although some think they taste like menthol.

404020013.name: Nightingale Tomato Braised Fish
404020013.desc: Nightingale brand sweet and sour canned herring in tomato sauce. Has a long shelf life.

404020014.name: Nom Nom Baked Beans
404020014.desc: A can of baked white kidney beans in tomato sauce. Can be eaten straight from the can, but it tastes better when hot. A popular item during food shortages.

404020015.name: Cornflakes
404020015.desc: A new fast food made from corn. Nutritious and healthy. Eat it directly or process it into other foods.

404020016.name: Dawing Original Sweet Bean Sauce
404020016.desc: A sauce made from fermented flour. Sweet and salty. Suitable for all ages.

404020017.name: Dawing Original Energy Bar
404020017.desc: A chocolate energy bar made by Dawing Co. Ltd. Provides energy and enhances athletic abilities.

404020018.name: Special Field Ration
404020018.desc: Nutritious military-issue biscuits with a long shelf-life. Very satisfying.

404020019.name: Nightingale Honey
404020019.desc: Pure honey from a high-quality source. Rich, sweet, and nutritious.

404020033.name: Cheese Pizza
404020033.desc: An unopened pizza. The smell and warmth are coming through the box. It tastes better warm, so eat it fast!

405010001.name: Old Master Bedroom Key
405010001.desc: The key to the main bedroom on the second floor of the Farm Villa. Precious items may be stored there.

405010003.name: Old Stables Warehouse Key
405010003.desc: Key to the warehouse near the Farm Stables.

405010004.name: Old Motel 201 Key
405010004.desc: A key to room 201 in the outer corridor on the second floor of the Farm Motel.

405010006.name: Old Motel Main Guest Room Key
405010006.desc: Key to the main guest room on the second floor of the Farm Motel. Guests with more discerning tastes choose this room, often leaving valuable items behind.

405010008.name: Recycling Office Key
405010008.desc: An old key to the recycling management office under the Farm Bridge.

405010009.name: Loading Area Key
405010009.desc: Key to the locked room in the Farm Loading Area, which contains some weapons.

405010010.name: House Key
405010010.desc: A key to the door of the house located in the northeast corner of the Farm.

405010013.name: Old Barn Office Key
405010013.desc: Key to the office on the second floor of the Farm's Grain Trade Center. There may be valuable items inside.

405010080.name: Graveyard Key
405010080.desc: A key carried by Militants. Used to unlock a room near the graveyard in the Farm. You can find valuable items collect by the Militants.

405010901.name: Master Bedroom Key
405010901.desc: The key to the main bedroom on the second floor of the Farm Villa. Precious items may be stored there.

405010903.name: Stables Warehouse Key
405010903.desc: Key to the warehouse near the Farm Stables.

405010904.name: Motel 201 Key
405010904.desc: A key to room 201 in the outer corridor on the second floor of the Farm Motel.

405010906.name: Motel Main Guest Room Key
405010906.desc: Key to the main guest room on the second floor of the Farm Motel. Guests with more discerning tastes choose this room, often leaving valuable items behind.

405010913.name: Barn Office Key
405010913.desc: Key to the office on the second floor of the Farm's Grain Trade Center. There may be valuable items inside.

405020001.name: A207 Key
405020001.desc: A key for hotel room 207 on the second floor of Northridge Hotel Building A, currently being used as an armory.

405020002.name: Old Building B Manager's Office Key
405020002.desc: Key to the hotel manager's room in the Office on the first floor of Northridge Hotel Building B. There might be valuable items inside.

405020003.name: B203 Key
