408060044.name: Handheld Fill Light
408060044.desc: A handheld light used to provide more illumination in environments where light is lacking.

408060045.name: Bag of Seeds
408060045.desc: A bag of full of crop seeds. The seeds inside are sealed in a plastic bag.

408060046.name: Camping Stove
408060046.desc: A portable stove that can provide a modest flame out of doors. A must-have item for campers.

408060047.name: Camping Lantern
408060047.desc: A waterproof lantern that serves as a reliable light source for campers at night.

408060048.name: Kamona Bird Plush
408060048.desc: The kamona is the state bird of the country of Kamona and is beloved by the locals of the region. A kamona plush toy produced by a local toy factory was so popular, it even sold out at one point in time.

408060050.name: Mug
408060050.desc: A dusty white porcelain mug. It probably needs a wash before it can be used.

408060051.name: Metal Spoon
408060051.desc: A slightly bent metal spoon. The tip is covered in scratches, as though someone once used it as a shovel.

408060052.name: Deluxe Tea Set
408060052.desc: An exquisite set that's best reserved for imported teas such as black tea. To a certain extent, their interest in tea serves as a contrast to the lifestyle of the locals.

408060054.name: Lute
408060054.desc: A well-preserved traditional plucked string instrument. It brings joy and comfort to life, even in times of hardship and war.

408070001.name: Glucose Injection
408070001.desc: Infusion bags stocked by local hospitals; used to maintain patients' fluids.

408070003.name: Thermometer
408070003.desc: A medical device used for taking temperature instantly.

408070005.name: H2O2
408070005.desc: Medical-grade peroxide; nurses use it for quick disinfection.

408070006.name: Medical Item Case
408070006.desc: A miscellany box containing many medical items.

408070007.name: Drug Nebulizer
408070007.desc: Liquid medicine pulverized into tiny particles that can enter the respiratory tract through inhalation for treatment purposes.

408070008.name: Medical Sponge
408070008.desc: A medical consumable commonly used in surgery. It acts as a filler to quickly treat wounds.

408070010.name: Bios.
408070010.desc: Unknown biological matter from a clinic; very popular on the Market.

408070012.name: Automated External Defibrillator
408070012.desc: A portable medical device that can be used by non-professionals to save patients who are in cardiac arrest.

408070013.name: Insulin Pump
408070013.desc: A high-end medical instrument consisting of a pump, a small syringe, and a cannula. Automatically injects micro volumes of insulin over time into the user to mimic the body's production of insulin.

408070014.name: Simple Thermometer
408070014.desc: A traditional thermometer. Uses the principle of thermal expansion to test for changes in a person's temperature. Easy, simple, and reliable.

408070015.name: Cotton Balls
408070015.desc: A bag of cotton balls for medical use. A survival item that's extremely popular among militants.

408070016.name: Metal Heart
408070016.desc: At its most basic level, a metal heart is really just an extremely durable mini-pump capable of replacing an organic heart. There might not be much demand for heart transplants in the Dark Zone, but people always need a sturdy little pump... even if it is a bit of wasted potential.

408080001.name: Gold Cheetah Statue
408080001.desc: A golden cheetah running. Or maybe it's a leopard?

408080002.name: Commemorative Coin
408080002.desc: Valuable commemorative coins. It might be a fake.

408080003.name: Vase
408080003.desc: A vase that looks very expensive. It records the life of a nobleman.

408080004.name: Gold Watch
408080004.desc: An expensive gold watch. The hour hand seems to be faulty.

408080009.name: Desk Clock
408080009.desc: A table clock with extremely exquisite craftsmanship.

408080011.name: Silver Badge
408080011.desc: A silver badge with special meaning.

408080014.name: Porcelain
408080014.desc: Fragile porcelain. Its value lies in the patterns adorning its surface.

408080015.name: Gold-rimmed Glasses
408080015.desc: Gold-rimmed glasses that reflect the wearer's worth.

408080016.name: Stamp Album
408080016.desc: A special collection booklet for safe preservation of stamps.

408080020.name: Pocket Watch
408080020.desc: An intricately-crafted chain pocket watch with a beautifully-decorated caseback.

408080021.name: Stamp
408080021.desc: A voucher for sending mail. It's also a collectible.

408080022.name: Spur
408080022.desc: Marsden's son always dreamed about being a cowboy so, for his 12th birthday, Marsden got a blacksmith in the next town to make him a set of spurs. On the day of his son's birthday, Marsden got up early and headed to the blacksmith's. But then, he suddenly heard gunfire as he was returning to the Farm.

408080024.name: Gold Block
408080024.desc: Local goldsmiths process this Onotos gold; local rich people see it as a way to preserve their wealth so they stock up on it and store it at home.

408080025.name: Diamond Ring
408080025.desc: Expensive diamond ring set with a large diamond.

408080026.name: Brooch
408080026.desc: Brooch made by local jewelers. It is expensive but beautiful and very popular in local stores.

408080027.name: Secret Document
408080027.desc: The most mysterious file in the Dark Zone. It is rumored to contain the truth about a certain event and every faction in the Dark Zone would pay to get their hands on it.

408080028.name: Gold Cube
408080028.desc: Kamona's most famous goldsmith randomly created this cube while forging gold jewelry. Both goldsmith and cube disappeared from the island. Generations later, local goldsmiths began re-creating this cube in his memory, making this golden cube a popular collector's item in the area.

408080029.name: Gem Necklace
408080029.desc: Master goldsmiths set choice gemstones on just the right Onotos gold to create this dazzling necklace.

408080030.name: G. Cup
408080030.desc: This handmade artisanal gold cup was sold for a shocking price at auction; from this point, people began to see the collectible value of Kamona goldware.

408080033.name: Vintage Typewriter
408080033.desc: A typewriter from Colom that many large companies purchased in bulk due to its reasonable price and durability. Some local merchants came together to bring in a shipment of these typewriters and later sold them to local companies.

408080034.name: Decorative Cane
408080034.desc: A decorative cane made by a local craftsman. Its exquisite form and quality materials make it a potential collectible.

408080038.name: Plaster Sculpture
408080038.desc: A practice piece with no name. Passable, but the student clearly put their heart into their work.

408080039.name: Majestic Sculpture
408080039.desc: A forged sculpture made of plaster and gold. The exquisite details show that its maker was a master of their craft. According to the locals, the sculpture was once used as a decoration in a Marulos party and was the brightest star of the night.

408080040.name: Utopia Hazmat Case
408080040.desc: A case of mysterious experimental reagents containing a partially erased Toland Group marker and several experiment reports. No one knows anything about the case's contents—except that these items would fetch a high price on the black market.

408080041.name: Gold Snake
408080041.desc: A golden serpent coiled tightly around some ore. Grab the wealth that falls into your lap and never let it go!

408080042.name: Handmade Hunting Knife
408080042.desc: Before the war, this exquisitely handmade hunting knife was often carried around as a symbol of courage and wealth. Yet now, the hunting knife here may be proof that a luxurious personal weapon is useless in the face of a collective crisis.

408080047.name: Skyhook Synchronized Array Mirror
408080047.desc: The secondary reflector of the Skyhook Guidance System by Ring of Nibelungen. It entered the black market due to manufacturing defects. This collection of defective products allowed the public to gain a glimpse into Project Gungnir, yet at the same time, scholars of related fields started to express more doubts about the project.

408080048.name: Sergey 1 Satellite Model
408080048.desc: A model of the world's first satellite launched by Tevila. Even though the Sergey 1 only remained in orbit for 20 days, it was enough to be labeled a key step in scientific research and a monumental moment in human history.

408080049.name: Raw Diamond Ore
408080049.desc: Most would find this unremarkable stone easy to overlook without a certificate from a geologist, not even if it was displayed in a high-quality display cabinet. Though there is never a shortage of collectors willing to pay a high price for raw ores like this.

408080050.name: Jade Bracelet
408080050.desc: A jade bracelet made of vibrant, dense, and flawless beads with a superior texture.

408080054.name: Gold Pen
408080054.desc: A gilded, standard fountain pen with a faint Oligarch ID etched into its cap. It's likely to have been distributed by an oligarch department, though the reason they have appeared in the Dark Zone remains a mystery to be uncovered.

408090001.name: Document
408090001.desc: What looks to be an obsolete file.

408090002.name: Hardcover
408090002.desc: Hardcover notebooks from local stationery factories; a hit with wealthy local kids.

408090004.name: Folder
408090004.desc: Strange writings and graphs in an unmarked folder. It's in English, but you barely understand any of it. The word "Gungnir" appears multiple times. First found in the farm.

408090005.name: Desk Calendar
408090005.desc: A paper calendar on which each day has a different meaning.

408090015.name: Sticky Notes
408090015.desc: A pile of sticky notes. Stuck together with a weak non-drying adhesive, they are easy to peel off.

408090016.name: Old Book
408090016.desc: An old book. Its cover shows the passage of time but you can still make out its title. The densely packed annotations and dog-eared pages inside may never see the light of day again.

408090019.name: Gungnir Blueprint Fragments
408090019.desc: A collection of torn-apart Gungnir blueprint fragments. The contents seem to include sections of an enormous rail, whose design is consistent with the international standard launcher and has not been adapted for any specific country or region.

408100001.name: Gas Analyzer
408100001.desc: An analyzer used by scientists to analyze the components of gas.

408100002.name: Air Tightness Tester
408100002.desc: Locally produced air-tightness test tools. Affordable, simple and a favorite with engineers.

408100003.name: Pressure Gauge
408100003.desc: A device used to measure pressure. However, it cannot measure mental pressure.

408100004.name: Multimeter
408100004.desc: You can't tell it's a counter or a universal meter.

408100005.name: Wave Filter
408100005.desc: A special power filter used in armored vehicles.

408100007.name: Oscilloscope
408100007.desc: An instrument that assists users in observing electrical signals.

408100010.name: Rectifier
408100010.desc: A device that converts alternating currents to direct currents. It can also charge batteries.

408100011.name: Antenna
408100011.desc: An ordinary antenna for civilian use. Only a few local families have use for it, though.

408100012.name: Gimbal
408100012.desc: A balancing apparatus for cameras that stabilizes the frame when in use.

408100013.name: Light Meter
408100013.desc: An instrument that measures light intensity and, when conditions are met, is capable of calculating the aperture value for optimal exposure.

408120001.name: Weapon Parts
408120001.desc: Parts disassembled from weapons. They can be recycled.

408120003.name: Paracord
408120003.desc: Parachute cord. It is extremely strong and durable.

408120004.name: Safety Cord
408120004.desc: The safety rope is the lifeline in the abseiling movement.

408120005.name: Military Canteen
408120005.desc: An aluminum military-issue water bottle. Makes it easy to carry clean water.

408120006.name: Filter Canister
408120006.desc: The filter device of a gas mask. It's still usable.

408120007.name: Military Compass
408120007.desc: A military compass used to indicate directions.

408120008.name: Rangefinder Binoculars
408120008.desc: A telescope with a laser ranging feature.

408120009.name: Portable Transceiver
408120009.desc: A handheld, wireless walkie-talkie with an extra-short wavelength.

408120010.name: Military Radio
408120010.desc: Old radio stations may still be able to intercept useful information.

408120013.name: TI Module
408120013.desc: Components of a thermal imaging system.

408120014.name: Radio
408120014.desc: A station that can transmit and receive radio signals; usually found in local signal stations.

408120017.name: Leveler
408120017.desc: A tool used to test leveling; handle with care to ensure accurate results.

408120018.name: Bosun's Whistle
408120018.desc: A whistle used in the navy by the bosun to convey various orders on a warship. Today, it is used by naval patrol captains to call the patrol to the battlefield.

408120019.name: Target Positioning Module
408120019.desc: One of the components of the military laser rangefinder. This is the module for target positioning.

408120020.name: Laser Pointer Module
408120020.desc: One of the components of the military laser rangefinder. This is the laser pointer module.

408120021.name: Artillery Periscope Binoculars
408120021.desc: These periscope binoculars can be used to observe the enemy target and measure the distance and angle without the user revealing their position.

408130001.name: Battleforged Badge
408130001.desc: A worn, scratched badge. In Renoir's eyes, it has long ceased to symbolize honor.

408130002.name: Pocket Knife
408130002.desc: A well-crafted saber. For Ajax, it represents that he has the approval of powerful people.

408130003.name: Fred's Wedding Ring
408130003.desc: A gold ring that Fred keeps close. While the weight of the ring can be felt, the person it represents will never return. He lost the original ring in the Siege of Onotos then later, captured the Onotos gold mine and ordered a famous local goldsmith to use the gold there and recreate it based on Fred's memory.

408130004.name: Handmade Gold
408130004.desc: An ancient gold coin engraved with patterns. It's covered in signs of wear. Doss holds it every day, feeling the authority and power he was taken with his own hands. Doss returned to the Valley with the help of his partners and resumed the family business of dealing weapons and drugs. He simultaneously uses his various identities to establish profitable links with various Dark Zone factions.

408130005.name: Compass
408130005.desc: A high-performance compass used by special forces to quickly determine distances and azimuth angles. This particular compass was a parting gift from Kurt's former captain, and Kurt has used this compass to lead his team out of danger in the complex battlefield that is the desert.

408130006.name: Brass Knuckles
408130006.desc: A set of rather heavy brass knuckles. While it has seen years of use, it has obviously been well cared for by its owner. Although Rolf, ever the combat enthusiast, has since moved on to handier weapons, he still carries this reminder of the past.

408130007.name: Airborne Badge
408130007.desc: A regulation badge for members of Colom's special air service task force. It bears the image of a parachute. Each and every owner of this badge is undoubtedly an elite. Bernard has continued to carry this reminder of his past glory after his retirement.

408130012.name: Immaculate Carabiner
408130012.desc: As the climbing expert of her team, Hecate always has a simple climbing tool on her person. Also, it doesn't have any marks on it, Hecate is constantly polishing this tool. This is because Hecate knows that in a moment of crisis, this tool will have to save more just than herself.

408140001.name: Game Console
408140001.desc: It is broken. It was the star product of the holidays.

408140005.name: DVD
408140005.desc: It is the latest music player, provided that you can afford the corresponding disc.

408140008.name: Fuse
408140008.desc: Civilian electric fuses are often used for safety in electrical circuits.

408140009.name: Card Reader
408140009.desc: A device used to identify RFID cards. It is quite hard to come by.

408140011.name: BP Machine
408140011.desc: A blue BP machine, the receiver of the called user in the wireless paging system.

408140014.name: Classic Radio
408140014.desc: A radio with poor sound quality.

408140015.name: Lens
408140015.desc: A lens used in video capture devices and security systems. It's very fragile, so please handle with care.

408140016.name: Camera
408140016.desc: A heavy optical device. Its flash is useful for nighttime photography.

408140017.name: Cassette Walkman
408140017.desc: Portable audio equipment that can hold cassettes.

408140019.name: Gold Phone
408140019.desc: A golden phone that looks very expensive.

408140021.name: Data Cable
408140021.desc: An ordinary data cable that can be used to transfer data between computers.

408140022.name: Video Camera
408140022.desc: An imported video camera designed for civilian use. While it looks a little old, it works perfectly fine.

408140023.name: Shutter Cable
408140023.desc: An ordinary-looking camera shutter cable that allows the user to release the camera shutter remotely.

408140024.name: Laptop Computer
408140024.desc: A new kind of computer that has exploded in popularity overseas. While it is highly portable, it also commands a rather hefty price tag. Only a few wealthy families are likely to buy it.

491050006.name: Experimental Ultra-Strength Treatment
491050006.desc: Use it to immediately heal limb injuries and other debuffs. You'll also obtain enhanced regeneration and faster HP recovery.

491050008.name: Experimental Physique Enhancing Pill
491050008.desc: Use it to significantly enhance your physique. It increases the HP limit of the abdomen and all four limbs.

498050001.name: High-Frequency Coil
498050001.desc: A high-frequency coil is a type of distributed-parameter, series-resonant transformer capable of handling over one million volts. Among hobbyists, this device is known as an "artificial lightning spitter."

498060001.name: Space Lab Toybox
498060001.desc: The "Space Lab" was a complex toy meant to help educate children about space. Produced by a toy manufacturer in Colom, it was delicately crafted—and extremely expensive. Less than a year after Space Lab was released, consumers discovered the toy came packaged with a small bottle of caustic, highly poisonous rocket propellant, after which it was quickly pulled from shelves by the Toy Association.

498060002.name: Skateboard
498060002.desc: A commemorative skateboard manufactured by Colom's Radical Boards, Inc. It was made to resemble a board used in a classic sci-fi movie.

498060003.name: Quantum 2000 Toy Robot
498060003.desc: A toy robot designed by a well-known toy manufacturer in Colom. It can be programmed using a built-in cassette tape, and its actions recorded with a remote control. The robot also functions as a simple cassette player. Due to its high price, it was discontinued after a limited production run. Years later, its rarity has made it a valuable collector's item.

498070001.name: Handheld Tester
498070001.desc: A handheld medical tester. Precisely extracts a sample and provides the requested results.

498070002.name: EEG
498070002.desc: The EEG is an advanced medical device developed by Toland Group's first medical department. It collects data on and monitors brain waves, providing essential, technological data to support medical diagnoses and scientific research. However, rumors have always circulated on the black market that the first medical department conducted illegal experiments on the brains of refugees to perfect this device.

498070003.name: Blood Glucose Meter Set
498070003.desc: A blood glucose meter set from Elisir Medicina. The box contains a portable glucose meter, a lancet, and insulin.

498080001.name: Gilded Cage Music Box
498080001.desc: One of Colom's most venerated watchmakers produced this limited-edition music box to commemorate 100 years in business. Delicately crafted in the form of a gilded cage, this stunning piece was sold out before it even hit the shelves.

498080002.name: Phaethon's Clock
498080002.desc: The specter of Sumek still haunts the hearts of some people. Fearing the day they dread so much may come, these fearful folks created this special clock in the name of Phaethon, son of the sun god.

498080003.name: "Dawn"
498080003.desc: An oil painting created by one of Tevila's most famous artists after the Sumek comet was discovered.

498080004.name: T-008 Robotic Arm
498080004.desc: The arm of a robot from a beloved sci-fi blockbuster, fashioned from titanium alloy as a collector's piece by cinema superfans.

498080005.name: Real Matrix
498080005.desc: "Face the truth or indulge in a fabrication?" To commemorate the classic science-fiction film, the renowned Colom jewelry company has released a limited-edition gemstone collectible.

498080006.name: Ancient Golden Mask Replica
498080006.desc: Based on the golden mask of the most famous ruler in the history of the desert, this exquisite 1:1 replica was copied from the museum original. With the enormous amount of gold and gemstones used in its creation and the fact that it was handcrafted by contemporary masters, this modern replica is extremely valuable to collectors.

498080008.name: Hefra Egg
498080008.desc: The Hefra Egg, also known as the Tevila Egg, is a precious collectible from a series created by the famous Tevilan jeweler, Paul Auster. The egg is named after the Hefra River, the mother river of Tevila.

498080009.name: Lyre
498080009.desc: The lyre is one of the earliest plucked string instruments, often appearing as a symbol of music in the mythology of various nations in the Ocean Alliance. This particular lyre is an expensive custom collector's piece, made by a renowned luxury instrument workshop in Colom for its centennial celebration.

498080010.name: Heavenly Sphere
498080010.desc: A precious collectible crafted by professional Eastern artisans. Its design is inspired by an important astronomical instrument from an ancient Eastern kingdom used for observing celestial phenomena. The dragon-shaped base supporting the armillary sphere represents the eight mountain pillars that hold up the sky in Eastern mythology.

498080011.name: Peacock Fan
498080011.desc: A handheld fan handcrafted from peacock feathers, gold, and jewels. It was inspired by an ancient kingdom that revered peacocks. Legend has it that they used peacock feather fans as ceremonial regalia exclusively for the monarch, symbolizing royalty and protection.

498080012.name: Chaotic Matter
498080012.desc: ■■■ is a non-Newtonian fluid-like energy-matter composite, adhered to the foundational space-time continuum of ■■■■. It manifests as a constantly surging dark luster. It possesses extremely powerful meme-distorting properties and can erode reality. Based on the conclusions of existing research papers, we theorize that ■■■ "edits" the laws of physics it comes into contact with, making them more unstable and more detectable to an observer. There is now sufficient evidence to suggest ■■■ is the source and basic compositional material of the vast majority of strange phenomena recorded in ■■■■. To prevent the spread of this memetic hazard, we have named ■■■ "Chaotic Matter."

498080013.name: Spirit Photograph
498080013.desc: A spirit photograph taken of ■■■■. The photo shows a strangely shaped humanoid creature. According to rumors, its true identity is that of an operator from a squad that was carrying out a ■■ mission in ■■■■.

498080014.name: Distorted Crystal
498080014.desc: A Distorted Crystal found in the Distorted Valley. Its composition is similar to obsidian, but there's an apparently biological structure in its center. Using sliced sample analysis, we have confirmed traces of ■■■ in there, as well as some biological reactions. We theorize this is a metabolic byproduct of ■■■■ after it was distorted by ■■■.

498080015.name: Mystic Stone
498080015.desc: A Mystic Stone found in the Distorted Valley. The back is engraved with a standard circular geometric pattern, while the front is etched with strange symbols of unknown meaning. We consulted the available literature and historical records but failed to find the meanings of these symbols. However, after ■■■ activated it, we were able to obtain some information on ■■■■ from the stone.

498090001.name: Voss' Journal
498090001.desc: The journal of famed bunker survivalist Voss. Outlined within are instructions for constructing a personal underground shelter, a 180-day survival plan, guides on water filtration, and other tips and tricks for living under extreme conditions. Only a few copies of the journal have been printed, and it has only been distributed among select groups. The work is known for its unique titanium alloy cover.

498090002.name: Space Boy Comic
498090002.desc: "Space Boy," a Colom superhero comic book. It tells the tale of an alien with superhuman abilities who joined the Earth Alliance and helped them avert galactic calamities.

498100001.name: Aerospace Navigator
498100001.desc: A special navigation device once used in the Tevilan space program. This electromechanical analog computer uses an intricate system of gears, cams, and differentials to help spacecraft determine their position.

498100002.name: K7-L Cipher Machine
498100002.desc: A famous cipher designed by the Colom Defense Intelligence Service. By integrating rotor and electronic technologies, its safety and convenience have both been significantly enhanced.

498100003.name: Three-Axis Gyro Controller Prototype
498100003.desc: A miniature prototype of a three-axis gyroscope controller for aerospace use. The genuine device was used in Tevila's Blizzard space shuttle. As a prototype for a key component of a groundbreaking spacecraft, it is extremely valuable among elite collectors.

498120001.name: Military Tool Kit
498120001.desc: A military tool kit, full of gear capable of solving a variety of battlefield emergencies.

498120002.name: Nonlinear Node Detector
498120002.desc: A nonlinear node detector from Colom. It can be used during security checks to locate well-hidden electronic devices, such as bugs or cameras. When compared to a metal detector, it stands out for its ability to find objects hidden in walls.

498120003.name: T-147 Individual Communication Device
498120003.desc: A small, portable radio issued by Tevila to its frontline troops. It grants access to FM and AM stations.

498140001.name: Prototype Calculation Module
498140001.desc: A calculation module for the TESM-6 prototype computer produced by Svarog's military-industrial complex. It was once a contender for inclusion in Tevila's newest generation of supercomputers, but was beaten out in the final stages by a similar product produced by Omas' military-industrial complex. In the end, the TESM-6 project went bankrupt, and this module found its way onto the black market.

498140002.name: Petso
498140002.desc: An extremely popular toy. Allows the user to raise an electronic pet within an egg-shaped game console.

498140003.name: Capsule TV
498140003.desc: The Capsule TV is a brand-new smart TV. It's portable, has an HD display, and includes smart interaction features. It was once a major milestone for Global United Comms, part of their entry into the consumer entertainment market, but later on, increasingly fierce competition caused the Capsule TV to be pushed out by newer products. As a result, there aren't many units left, which have made them quite valuable to collectors.
